g.text: From the mean matrix M to the flow of the tumor
Two-type reduction: sensitive (S) and resistant (R). The numbers on the left are the arrows on the right.
Full model: m_g uses each genotype's own d, q and therapy kill.
M is NOT a probability matrix; row sums are m.
Arrows = one-generation expected change E[(S',R') | s] − (S,R) on the baseline slice; shared length scale. Lines = actual trials of the full model (with oncogenes):
b shows each trial before therapy, c from therapy start on. Trials run along the arrows: rightward before therapy, then left to S = 0 and up the R axis (beyond the plotted range).
On linear axes the paths hug the edges because R stays below a few hundred cells before therapy; phase portrait 01 shows the same paths in log coordinates.
